description: Write, rewrite, edit, and adapt blogs, essays, emails, newsletters, scripts, copy, and professional documents.

defaultPrompt: Write a polished draft from this idea.
Rewrite this text for my audience and tone.
Turn these notes into a clear, complete document.
interface.longDescription: Write For Me is a multi-skill writing workspace for blogs, academic work, essays, emails, newsletters, copywriting, scripts, social posts, technical documents, resumes, proposals, speeches, and everyday writing. It adapts structure, voice, audience, evidence, length, and format while preserving the user's facts and intent.

name: write-for-me
